decision_needed.question: The Depreciation Fund shows a 90,000 'Allocation from General Fund' as a receipt (Exhibit III counts it in Non-Revenue Receipts), but the General Fund's transfers out are only 260,000 (to Nutrition 120,000 and Activities 140,000). Is the 90,000 a transfer (with matching General Fund spending hidden in a disbursement line such as 2710 Property 90,000) or genuine receipts? Note: account code 5200 is the same code Schedules F and G use for 'Transfers From General Fund', which suggests a transfer; no page shows an elimination or reclassification.
decision_needed.recorded_as: receipt, category other (review); not treated as a transfer

notes: Modified cash basis school district (governmental funds only). Receipts/disbursements from Exhibit III total column (Statement of Modified Cash Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Fund Balances, trimmed pp8-15; left half on even pages, Total Governmental Funds column on odd pages 9/11/13/15). Beginning 4,152,823.94 + receipts 7,139,080.61 + transfers in 260,000 - disbursements 7,413,491.42 - transfers out 260,000 = ending 3,878,413.13. Ending cash is the fund balance (cash and deposits 3,410,945.89 + county treasurers' balance 467,467.24). Broad statement lines (Local, State, Non-Revenue) were split using the fund schedules (each split item marked computed; splits tie to the printed lines). Attempt 2 (user rules): Local Receipts split now separates Penalties and Interest on Taxes 11,467.37 from property tax, Carline Tax 448.99 and Public Power District Sales Tax 13,347.00 (no longer other taxes), and Extracurricular Receipts 119,509.90 (activities 1710/1750/1790 + student fee 1741) from fees/rentals 17,780; State Receipts split into Homestead Exemption 27,047.51, Property Tax Credit 1,845,118.02, Motor Vehicle Pro-Rate 13,871.37, state aid 1,111,072.72 and Nameplate Capacity Tax 471,980.08, all from the fund schedules (pp17, 24, 26, 27). Debt Services 263,541 (p13) split into Bond principal 165,000, Bond interest/fees 85,010 (84,610 + 400) and the General Fund column's 13,531 (printed only as Schedule M 5000 Debt Service 'Miscellaneous') kept as principal and interest combined. Statement line Instruction-Related Technology (2230) is support services / Staff. Balance sheet (user cash-basis rule 2026-10-27): from the governmental funds statement of assets and fund balances (Exhibit III p15, Total Governmental Funds column: Committed 544,414.61, Assigned 1,132,430.07, Unassigned 2,201,568.45), whose total 3,878,413.13 equals the Statement of Net Position (p1, Unrestricted 3,878,413.13; no liabilities). Detail: General Fund disbursements are recorded from Schedule M (program by object), which supersedes the function-only Schedule B (Schedule B not recorded to avoid double counting); Schedule M's printed total 6,178,233.50 includes the 260,000 transfers (shown as signed other financing lines). Object mapping: Employee Benefits/Retirement/Increased Retirement Contribution = employee benefits; Purchased Professional/Technical = professional/contract services; Purchased Property Services = repairs and maintenance; Other Property Services = professional/contract services; Property = equipment purchases. Schedule M lists budget only at the program level, so line budget_final is null. Zero-actual lines omitted except Schedule I 4500-450 (budget only). Schedule A-1 summary (p16) and Schedule B not recorded. Exhibit III shows General Fund transfer lines only in the total; the activities and nutrition transfers in match Schedules F and G (140,000 and 120,000). Read pages 1-40 of 40
